findings.motion: SB 7 passed on third reading (Record 848), 78 yeas, 64 nays
findings.note: Voted nay on House passage of SB 7 (2021 regular session), a bill described in its caption as relating to election integrity and security, with new criminal offenses; the House text includes a section on the form of identification presented.

findings.passage: When Record No. 61 was taken, I was absent because of important business. I would have voted no.
findings.note: Statement of vote printed in the House Journal after she was absent for the House passage of SB 1 (second called session, 2021), a bill on election integrity and security that also covers ID numbers on mail ballot applications and envelopes. She states how she would have voted.

findings.passage: We brought the fight to D.C. to ensure that we have the backing and the support at the federal level.
findings.note: Quoted in a Texas Standard interview after she left the state with other House members to prevent a quorum on a 2021 voting bill; she says they went to Washington to ask for federal voting rights legislation. Nothing in the quoted text is specific to ID or citizenship.

findings.passage: I’m joining my colleagues and heading down to DC today to make it clear that we need comprehensive voting rights protections NOW!
findings.note: Her social media post of 2021-07-12 (as embedded in the Texas Standard story), about leaving for Washington over the 2021 voting bill. Nothing in it is specific to ID or citizenship.
